containment: inner Registry.containment must be INHERITED_OUTER_GROUP, actual caller PID==PG==SID; same-group kill/reap precedes parent TERMINAL
dependency: internal COMPLETE completed_at>=BOUND and hash/completion-time match own durable TERMINAL for exact request/BOUND; initial originals remain pinned before REQUEST

ledger.at: real native UTC, ignores supplied timestamp
ledger.claim_commit: reserved-key pins exact durable CLAIM hash and marker hash before any callback/effect
ledger.consume: immutable scoped marker anchored to chain sequence/previous SHA, request/BOUND; same operation cannot be reused
ledger.lock: fresh file description per bounded flock; lock before exclusive marker
ledger.orphan: under lock, only complete uncommitted marker with exact head anchor is adopted CLAIM+TERMINAL UNCERTAIN; never effect
ledger.rollback: retained commit proof against absent/changed chain is HOLD; no silent markers superset
ledger.same_disk_selected_limit: simultaneous rollback of entire elected root/ledger/proofs cannot be independently detected; external witness not automatically required under D1
ledger.terminal_commit: terminal-key pins exact durable TERMINAL hash; dependency accepts only committed COMPLETE
ledger.torn_tail_or_partial_proof: HOLD globally, no repair or erase

lock_refusal: REFUSED_NOT_RESERVED, effect_calls0, no marker or callback. This is no authorization for retry, J2/J3, catchup or reschedule: installer/casca must consume the logical Monday slot once and enforce D1 no retry even on this result. automatic_retry=False.
native_storage_limit: claim/source reads/fsync/terminal operate in parent as source-owned native primitives; OS-blocked storage cannot have a user-space hard realtime guarantee
